evidence.author: nurtecodt
evidence.content: See full PI at @nurtecodt_pi. Part 1: Setting the Stage​ Nurtec ODT is for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura and the preventive treatment of episodic migraine in adults. Don't take more than 1 tablet in 24 hours. It is not known if it is safe to take more than 18 doses of Nurtec ODT in 30 days. Select Safety Information: Do not take if allergic to Nurtec ODT. Allergic reactions can occur, even days after using. Allergic reactions can include trouble breathing and rash. Call your HCP or get emergency help right away if you have swelling of the face, mouth, tongue, or throat, trouble breathing, or rash. High blood pressure and a circulation problem called Raynaud’s phenomenon can worsen or occur after taking Nurtec ODT. Contact your healthcare provider if you have an increase in blood pressure or your fingers or toes feel numb, cool, or painful, or change color from pale, to blue, to red. Most common side effects were nausea (2.7%) and indigestion/stomach pain (2.4%).

evidence.content: See full PI at @nurtecodt_pi. Part 1: Setting the Stage​ Nurtec ODT is for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura and the preventive treatment of episodic migraine in adults. Don't take more than 1 tablet in 24 hours. It is not known if it is safe to take more than 18 doses of Nurtec ODT in 30 days. Select Safety Information: Do not take if allergic to Nurtec ODT. Allergic reactions can occur, even days after using. Allergic reactions can include trouble breathing and rash. Call your HCP or get emergency help right away if you have swelling of the face, mouth, tongue, or throat, trouble breathing, or rash. High blood pressure and a circulation problem called Raynaud’s phenomenon can worsen or occur after taking Nurtec ODT. Contact your healthcare provider if you have an increase in blood pressure or your fingers or toes feel numb, cool, or painful, or change color from pale, to blue, to red. Most common side effects were nausea (2.7%) and indigestion/stomach pain (2.4%).
